description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams DL Aaron Donald is uncertain for the season opener next Thursday against the 49ers.
items.impact: Rams coach Sean McVay said he expects every player to travel with the team to Australia, which includes Donald. If he is cleared to play, it is likely he'll be on some sort of snap count.
items.title: Aaron Donald uncertain for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys restructured the contract of DaRon Bland.
items.impact: Bland was one of three players to have his contract restructured by Dallas. The Cowboys now have $33.2 million in salary cap space.
items.title: DaRon Bland restructures contract with Cowboys

items.desc: The Cowboys restructured TE Jake Ferguson's contract.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans agreed to terms with Tank Dell on a one-year, $1.7 million contract restructure.
items.impact: The move saves Houston $2 million against the cap. Dell is nearing his return from a gruesome knee injury he suffered late in the 2024 season.
items.title: Tank Dell restructures contract with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bears RB D'Andre Swift left practice early on Thursday due to "a cramp."
items.impact: Swift was seen leaving practice "holding at his midsection or core area." It appears he should be good to go for the season opener next week.
items.title: D'Andre Swift left practice Thursday with a cramp

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Sam Okuayinonu (foot) is out against the LA Rams in the 49ers 2026 season opener.
items.impact: Okuayinonu didn't make the flight with the team down to Melbourne, but they left the door open for him to come down later. He will now try to get himself healthy and ready for Week 2.
items.title: Sam Okuayinonu (foot) out against LA Rams

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Devin Neal has been waived by the New Orleans Saints after reaching an injury settlement.
items.impact: Neal was originally placed on IR, but it seems the team has found a way to settle things and enact his release. He could find a new team, but cannot sign with the Saints again until at least three weeks from now.
items.title: Devin Neal waived by Saints

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rome Odunze left Thursday's practice early with an apparent injury.
items.impact: Hammond notes that Odunze came up hobbling during an install period at the start of practice. He tried to return to practice, but trainers wouldn't let him. This will remain something to monitor into next week.
items.title: Rome Odunze leaves practice early Thursday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Will Levis worked out for the Jets on Thursday.
items.impact: Levis was cut loose by the Titans this past weekend and subsequently cleared waivers. The second-round pick from 2023 spent all of last season on the IL after starting 21 games for the Titans over the previous two campaigns. Levis is looking to catch on with the Jets or another team, most likely as a third QB.
items.title: Will Levis works out for Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson was not present for the media-access portion of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Henderson has not practiced since August 24 when he sustained the injury. His status is up in the air for the season opener next Wednesday.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) still not practicing Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Alec Pierce (ankle) practiced in full for the first time this year after a lengthy time off the field while recovering from ankle injuries.
items.impact: Pierce was limited in practice earlier this week, and this is the next big step for the newly anointed WR1 for the Colts on the road to full recovery and return to play. He will operate as the Colts primary deep threat this season when on the field, opening things up for Josh Downs and Tyler Warren over the middle and short areas.
items.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) practices in full on Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Michael Wilson has agreed to a three year, $75 million deal with the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Wilson was about to be playing on the final year of his rookie contract, but will now see himself attached to the team for the long haul. It will be interesting to see how his role changes, if at all, under a new coaching stafff and with Marvin Harrison Jr. back in the fold.
items.title: Michael Wilson agrees to three year, $75 million deal with Cardinals

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Anthony Richardson Sr. will be the Colts' No. 2 quarterback going into the season.
items.impact: There have been multiple rumors that Richardson might be traded at some point. Some reports have suggested that he may lose out to Riley Leonard for the Colts' backup QB role. Head coach Shane Steichen has put all that to rest, at least for now, making clear Tuesday that Richardson is indeed the top backup to starter Daniel Jones.
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. will be backup QB for Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons signed Zach Harrison to their practice squad.
items.impact: Harrison was previously waived by Atlanta. He returns on its practice squad.
items.title: Zach Harrison signs with Falcons practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed RB DeeJay Dallas to their practice squad.
items.impact: Dallas will add depth in the backfield for Minnesota.
items.title: DeeJay Dallas signs with Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Shemar Stewart was back at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was Stewart's first practice since hyperextending his left knee on the first practice of training camp July 29.
items.title: Shemar Stewart (knee) returns to practice
